question: T12 (task-fd1992253e1a8f91): on the desktop, with a Scrolling block's Design panel open, an arrow key with the focus in the page's frame (not on the panel): does it move the block, the value or the rows? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10). Select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'), a press on Wave Intensity 90; then, through one DevTools session, the frame's window focused by script (no press: the panel stays open; the frame's body then has the focus), one real key, and reads of the value, the focus and Undo and Redo 60 ms and 1200 ms after it ('keys'); then a read, Escape and a press on the page ('go'), and Cmd+Z until as built. F1: ArrowRight; F2: ArrowDown. R1 and R2 are two sessions (probe-w.mjs in the lane folder), each with plans of other tasks. Exit without saving each time.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: With the focus in the frame (its body) and the panel open, ArrowRight (F1) and ArrowDown (F2) move nothing: the value stays 90, the Scrolling block 1/2/5/26 and the Text block 3/2/5/10, 10 rows, Undo on and Redo off, the focus still in the frame; the panel stays open.
Escape keeps every area; one Cmd+Z takes back the press on 90. R1 and R2 read alike in every read (areas, rows, line, Undo and Redo, the value and the focus).
Not read: ArrowLeft and ArrowUp (inferred), the focus on the selected block's own element in the frame, the phone view, an arrow with a modifier.
